2.bug_scenario: The bug report is about implementing a 'read-only' state for the Checkbox component in the design system. The requirement is to add a new prop to the Checkbox component (in /package/react) that will visually indicate when a checkbox is in read-only mode, distinct from disabled. The visual design (from the images) shows that the read-only state uses the same structure and spacing as normal checkboxes, but will require specific styles to indicate its state. The fix requires: updating the Checkbox component logic to accept a readOnly prop, adding new styles for this state, adding stories for documentation and testing purposes, and adding RTL tests for accessibility/layout checks.
